data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

CANNELL CAPITAL LLC's most recent 13F, for the period ending June 30, 2026, shows positions in PCYO and GBLI.

On October 13, 2026, an Arapahoe County Board of County Commissioners business-meeting agenda item mentioned Sky Ranch (approval). (https://arapahoe.legistar.com/MeetingDetail.aspx?LEGID=3038&GID=826&G=9CD90149-B010-432C-9FC8-7BF802574B0E)

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
